visual.general_description: Black and white flowchart of a diagnostic algorithm for chronic dysphonia.
visual.detailed_description: A vertical flowchart of rectangular boxes joined by lines and arrowheads. The top box reads "CHRONIC DYSPHONIA". Below it a wide box reads "Investigate pulmonary TB symptoms: cough-hemoptysis, fever, night sweats, loss weight" and "Previous contact TB, immunosuppression". The path then divides: the left branch leads to a box "LARYNGOSCOPY", and the right branch leads to a box listing "1. Chest X-ray", "2. AFB, sputum culture" and "3. Molecular tests". From the right-hand test box, lines lead to boxes "NEGATIVE" and "POSITIVE". "NEGATIVE" leads to "Confirm laryngeal (primary) involvement", which leads to "LARYNGOSCOPY". "LARYNGOSCOPY" leads to "EVIDENCE OF LARYNGEAL LESIONS", then "BIOPSY", which divides to "TUBERCULOSIS" and "CANCER, other diseases". "POSITIVE" leads to "TUBERCULOSIS".
